points.title: E-government
points.must: Use of the Internet and digital technology by the state to provide public services online; egov.kz and the eGov mobile app.

points.title: Public service online
points.must: A state service (certificate, registration, payment, application) requested and received through the portal without visiting an office.

points.title: eGov services
points.must: At least five services: certificates, registration, education, health, taxes and fines, social payments, digital documents, elicense.kz.

points.title: Steps to receive a service
points.must: Log in → choose the service → check the auto-filled form → sign with EDS / SMS → result (PDF with QR code) in the personal account.

points.title: State databases
points.must: The portal fills in data by IIN from state databases, so paper copies are not needed.

points.title: Worked example
points.must: A real task (e.g. certificate of address registration) described step by step.

points.title: Advantages and disadvantages
points.must: A table: 24/7, saves time, less paperwork, less corruption, transparency vs digital divide, cyber-attacks / leaks, phishing, failures, shared keys.

points.title: Electronic digital signature
points.must: Cryptographic key pair (private key + public certificate from the National Certification Authority); proves who signed and that the document was not changed; legal force.

points.title: Ways to log in
points.must: EDS (key file + password), password + one-time SMS code, eGov mobile with biometrics — and the risk of each.

points.title: Phishing
points.must: Signs of a fake portal / SMS: urgent message, misspelled address, no HTTPS, asks for EDS password or SMS code.

points.title: Using eGov safely
points.must: Type egov.kz yourself / official app, never share EDS password or codes, log out on shared computers, check HTTPS, nobody else signs with your EDS.

points.title: Personal data and digital divide
points.must: Leaks → identity theft, fraud; digital divide (elderly, rural) and solutions (public service centres, training).
